yangzhou-1.name: Slender West Lake
yangzhou-1.bio: A narrow lake of pavilions, grown from Tang-era city moats and lined with Qing salt merchants' estates.
yangzhou-1.notes: Price is 2018 official policy via government-run China Daily page; Wikivoyage still shows 120 (stale). Seasonal range 30-100; adult peak 100. Free for students Jul-Aug. Cost range is seasonal (30-100 CNY, adult peak 100).

yangzhou-2.name: Geyuan Garden
yangzhou-2.bio: A Qing salt merchant's garden on Dongguan Street, known for its bamboo and stone, with sections for the four seasons.
yangzhou-2.notes: Price from 2017 China Daily government page; a Ctrip listing shows 48 but is an aggregator and not used.

yangzhou-3.name: He Garden
yangzhou-3.bio: The best-known private garden of the late Qing dynasty, with tea houses, open grottoes and pleasant views.
yangzhou-3.notes: Price from 2017 China Daily page; aggregator figures differ (45-48).

yangzhou-4.name: Dongguan Street
yangzhou-4.bio: An old-quarter street in eastern Yangzhou, lined with Geyuan Garden and the Taoist Wudangxing Palace.
yangzhou-4.notes: Open public street; free is inferred from it being a street, not from a stated price. No English Wikipedia article (Dongguan_Street is a missing page).

yangzhou-5.name: Daming Temple
yangzhou-5.bio: A temple on Shugang Mountain tied to Jianzhen, who ordained monks here in 742 before going to Japan.
yangzhou-5.notes: Price from 2017 China Daily page; climbing Qiling Pagoda costs extra (not counted).

yangzhou-6.name: Lu Family Salt Merchant Residence
yangzhou-6.bio: A lavishly furnished salt merchant's home on Kangshan Street, part of the Grand Canal World Heritage listing.
yangzhou-6.notes: NO PRICE FOUND (held for cost). No English Wikipedia article; zh Wikipedia has 卢氏盐商住宅 but no price. Trip.com page hints the area is under Grand Canal theme construction: check it is open before keeping.

yangzhou-7.name: Yangzhou Museum
yangzhou-7.bio: Yangzhou's largest museum by Mingyue Lake, with a Grand Canal boat and a woodblock printing museum on site.

yangzhou-8.name: China Grand Canal Museum
yangzhou-8.bio: A modern museum on the Grand Canal heritage site in Sanwan wetland park.

yangzhou-9.name: Xiaoqinhuai Canal
yangzhou-9.bio: A canal through the old city centre, with the narrow lanes of a few surviving old blocks nearby.
yangzhou-9.notes: Canal-side walk; free inferred. Wikipedia Xiaoqinhuai_River does not exist.

yangzhou-10.name: Wenchang Pavilion
yangzhou-10.bio: The surviving pavilion of a Confucian academy, standing in the roundabout that marks Yangzhou's symbolic centre.
yangzhou-10.notes: Seen from the roundabout; no entry fee stated; free inferred. Wikipedia Wenchang_Ge is a missing page.

yangzhou-11.name: Tianning Temple
yangzhou-11.bio: A large Buddhist temple with a hall holding a Siku Quanshu copy and statues of the Eight Eccentrics of Yangzhou.
yangzhou-11.notes: Wikipedia "Tianning Temple" is a disambiguation page, so wiki=null.

yangzhou-12.name: Shi Kefa Memorial
yangzhou-12.bio: Memorial temple for the Ming general Shi Kefa, who refused to surrender Yangzhou in 1645, with his clothing tomb.
yangzhou-12.notes: NO PRICE FOUND (held for cost). No English Wikipedia article.

yangzhou-13.name: Tomb of Puhaddin
yangzhou-13.bio: A park around the tomb of the Islamic missionary Puhaddin, with small exhibits on Yangzhou's Hui Muslim community.
yangzhou-13.notes: English Wikipedia "Tomb of Puhaddin" is a redirect to the person page Puhaddin, so wiki=null. Wikivoyage names it Puhaddin Park.

longshan-yizheng.name: Longshan Mountain Scenic Resort
longshan-yizheng.bio: A hilltop scenic resort and forest park in Qingshan town, the main draw of Yizheng city.
longshan-yizheng.held: no sourced cost; sourcing too thin (draft bio only)
longshan-yizheng.notes: NO PRICE, NO SOURCE BEYOND DRAFT: Wikivoyage has no Yizheng page and zh Wikipedia 龙山风景区 is a stub with nothing usable. UNRESOLVED; hold.

yucheng-postal-stop.name: Yucheng Postal Stop
yucheng-postal-stop.bio: China's largest and best-preserved ancient courier station, built in the early Ming dynasty outside Gaoyou's South Gate.
yucheng-postal-stop.notes: Wikivoyage Gaoyou, price dated 2021. Wikivoyage flags the link as dead. ticketUrl unverified: http://www.gyycy.cn/ENGLISH/

zhenguo-temple-gaoyou.name: Zhenguo Temple
zhenguo-temple-gaoyou.bio: A Buddhist temple on a small Grand Canal island, known for a pagoda little changed since the Tang dynasty.
zhenguo-temple-gaoyou.notes: English Wikipedia Zhenguo Temple is the Pingyao temple, so wiki=null.

gaoyou-old-town.name: Gaoyou Old Town
gaoyou-old-town.bio: A short walk through Gaoyou's old town, with antique shops, local goods and early-morning open-air food markets.

qianduo-xinghua.name: Qianduo Scenic Area
qianduo-xinghua.bio: Canola flower fields north of Xinghua, ringed by canals and toured by boat, in bloom from late March to April.
qianduo-xinghua.notes: Price dated 2018 and from Wikivoyage; the 99 includes the boat ride. Seasonal draw (bloom late Mar-Apr) per source.

taizhou-1.name: Wanghai Tower
taizhou-1.bio: A newly built tower in the Fengcheng River scenic area on Nanshansi Road in Hailing district.
taizhou-1.notes: NO PRICE FOUND (held for cost). Wikivoyage URL fengchenghe.com is a dead link and fails to load.

taizhou-2.name: Guangxiao Temple
taizhou-2.bio: A temple founded in the Eastern Jin dynasty, keeping a Five Dynasties bronze bell and a Qianlong-era Tripitaka.
taizhou-2.notes: NO PRICE FOUND. Only the Qing abbot building is old; other buildings rebuilt after 1988 (zh Wikipedia). Wikipedia title is a disambiguation page, so wiki=null.

taizhou-3.name: Mei Lanfang Memorial Hall
taizhou-3.bio: A memorial park and museum on the Mei family ancestral village site, with water on three sides.
taizhou-3.notes: NO PRICE FOUND from an operator/guide (only a Ctrip visitor review saying free; not used). Held for cost. Phone 0523-86363910 listed.

taizhou-4.name: PLA Navy Establishment Memorial Hall
taizhou-4.bio: A museum at Baima Temple marking where the East China Military Region Navy was founded on 23 April 1949.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/中国人民解放军海军诞生地纪念馆
taizhou-4.notes: NO PRICE FOUND (held for cost). No English Wikipedia article.

taizhou-5.name: Qinhu Lake National Wetland Park
taizhou-5.bio: A national wetland park in Jiangyan beside Qinhu Lake, with the main area across the water reached by boat.
taizhou-5.held: premise unsourced: Qinhu Lake wetland park facts (24.5 km, boat to main area) are not on the cited Wikivoyage page; no zh/en Wikipedia page loads; no cost
taizhou-5.notes: NO OFFICIAL/GUIDE PRICE. Ctrip listing shows 80 yuan (includes round-trip boat) but is an aggregator and not recorded as cost. Held for cost. Facts here are from Ctrip search snippet and need a second source before use.

taizhou-6.name: Qintong Ancient Town
taizhou-6.bio: An ancient town in Jiangyan district beside Qinhu Lake, rated a national 4A attraction.
taizhou-6.held: premise unsourced: Qintong Ancient Town and its 4A rating are not on the cited Wikivoyage page and no fetched source gives them; no cost
taizhou-6.notes: NO OFFICIAL/GUIDE PRICE. Ctrip shows 40 yuan (aggregator, not used). Held for cost. Source for 4A rating is only the draft/Ctrip snippet; needs a second source.

taizhou-7.name: Guluotang Cultural Block
taizhou-7.bio: A historic cultural block in northern Jiangyan district, rated a national 4A attraction.
taizhou-7.held: premise unsourced: Guluotang Cultural Block appears in no fetched source (Wikivoyage Taizhou does not list it); no cost
taizhou-7.notes: NO PRICE OR FREE SOURCE (held for cost). Thin sourcing: only draft bio and OSM tag; Wikivoyage Taizhou lists Jiangyan old neighbourhood but not this block by name.
